title: PerezBlanco2026: Wrist-motion (4-direction pointing) motor-execution dataset
description: A multimodal dataset of wrist-pointing movements recorded from 45 healthy adults using a 3-DoF wrist exoskeleton. Participants performed four movement directions (flexion, extension, radial deviation, ulnar deviation) that controlled a cursor, while 8 EEG channels over sensorimotor areas and 8 EMG channels were recorded. The dataset is intended for biomarker research, brain-computer interfaces and neurorehabilitation. This BIDS version was converted from the original BCI2000 recordings using MOABB.
methods_description: EEG (8 channels, 10-10 montage, g.tec g.GAMMAcap) and EMG (8 channels) were recorded at 512 Hz with a g.tec g.USBamp. The reference was the right ear and the ground was AFz. Online filtering used a 0.1-200 Hz bandpass and a 60 Hz notch. Participants completed at least 8 runs of 40 cue-based trials, 10 per movement direction per run, with continuous visual feedback while operating the Biomech Wrist exoskeleton. Data were converted from BCI2000 .dat to EDF/BIDS.
